note: Evidence registry. Every key figure on the site maps to one of these sources. Live endpoints are re-queried by the collector; code/doc links are stable references verified on the date above.

avalanche.label: platform.getCurrentValidators — Primary Network validator set, stake weight (incl. delegations), uptime
platform.getHeight — P-Chain height at collection time
avalanchego upgrade/upgrade.go — named network upgrades with compiled activation timestamps (Apricot..Helicon). Proof that upgrades ship in client software, not via an admin key.
avalanchego releases — validator operators adopt new binaries

polygon.label: Heimdall v2 REST /stake/validators-set — current active validator set + total voting power (CometBFT)
Heimdall v2 REST /bor/spans/latest — current span: block range, validator set, selected producers
Heimdall v2 REST /bor/spans/{id} — per-span producer history (rotation evidence)
Heimdall v2 REST /bor/params — sprint_duration=16, span_duration=6400, producer_count=50 (legacy selection param)
Heimdall v2 REST /bor/producer-votes — validator votes for block producers (veBlop)
Heimdall v2 REST /chainmanager/params — canonical L1 contract addresses used by the chain itself
Bor JSON-RPC bor_getCurrentValidators / bor_getSigners / bor_getAuthor — execution-layer cross-check of the span producer

heimdall-v2 x/bor/keeper/veblop.go — veBlop producer election: stake-weighted positional vote tally (CalculateProducerSet), round-robin SelectProducer, single producer frozen per span, client-side fallback list '91,92,93,94' (helper/config.go)

heimdall-v2 helper/config.go — named hardfork heights compiled into heimdalld (mainnet: phuket 44,070,000 / zurich 47,880,000 / ithaca 50,185,000 / kyoto 51,533,000 / lugano 54,627,000 / karwar 57,006,000)
heimdall-v2 app.go + x/bor msg_server.go — module params (MsgUpdateParams) gated by the x/gov module account authority

Ethereum mainnet on-chain reads: proxy slots keccak256('matic.network.proxy.implementation/owner'), Gnosis Safe getThreshold/getOwners, TimelockController getMinDelay/hasRole. Collector re-verifies every run.
StakeManagerProxy.sol verified source (UpgradableProxy with matic.network slots, updateImplementation = owner-gated upgrade)
Gnosis Safe 5-of-9 (owner of StakingInfo/StateSender/SlashManager; PROPOSER+EXECUTOR on the timelock)
TimelockController (owner of StakeManagerProxy/RootChainProxy). getMinDelay() = 0 seconds as of 2026-11-12.
staking-api.polygon.technology /api/v3/validators/{id} — operator-declared validator names (display only; never used to merge entities)

methodology_refs.label: CometBFT security model: >1/3 of voting power can halt finality; >2/3 can finalize conflicting blocks
Team Rocket, 'Scalable and Probabilistic Leaderless BFT Consensus through Metastability' (Snow/Snowball/Snowman analysis) — probabilistic safety; thresholds not directly comparable to BFT quorums
